title: [Feedback/Collab] Making a Roblox game 100% with Claude AI (zero coding experience). Looking for feedback and potential collabs! — From lawyer to solo Roblox dev: 4 weeks of progress (and a ton of bugs!).
author: Mediocre-Brush-5493
selftext:
Hey guys, I've been putting together a game in Roblox Studio for about 4 weeks now. At first, everything was pretty complicated (it still is)—I started out super disorganized, but after studying a lot, I put together a better schedule. Because of that initial mess, I had to redo a bunch of stuff. The upside is that every day I've learned new techniques.

The game is 100% made by Claude—I don't know how to code at all. I'm a lawyer and have never touched anything programming-related before. The point of this post is to show you guys my early progress, see if anyone likes what I'm doing, and maybe find people interested in joining the project.

I don't mind sharing anything I've done so far, including the framework/prompts I built for Claude to generate this art (which, modesty aside, is turning out way better than the usual Roblox standards I see).

As you can see, there are tons and tons of bugs. I'm working on fixing them. Criticism and suggestions are more than welcome. I also have a few more videos on YouTube if anyone wants to check them out.

IT'S NOT A PORT! AND I DIDN'T ASK AN AI TO CREATE SOMETHING BASED ON ANOTHER GAME. I MADE MY OWN WORLD SYSTEM AND MY OWN LORE. It's an MMORPG, so of course we're gonna have a mount system, an auction house, classes, and professions.

My english isn't that good, so it's a IA translate from portuguese.

[https://www.youtube.com/@AtomicSoda-m5s](https://www.youtube.com/@AtomicSoda-m5s)

Sorry for the background music—I had YouTube playing and didn't realize the recording would pick it up
